response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), stats AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_count, SUM(member_count) OVER () as total_members, AVG(member_count) OVER () as avg_count FROM major_counts) SELECT link_to_major, member_count, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / total_members as fraction, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / avg_count as ratio FROM stats ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
